title: Surface and near-surface stratigraphy map of the Williston 7.5-minute quadrangle, Barnwell and Aiken counties, South Carolina
citation: Willoughby, R.H., and Nystrom, P.G., Jr., 1995, Surface and near-surface stratigraphy map of the Williston 7.5-minute quadrangle, Barnwell and Aiken counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-75, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Single OCR'd map sheet; map face garbled in OCR and read on page images. Map symbols read from legend boxes on a page image. The text names no individual drill holes or thicknesses; the SCGS hole labels (2-xxx Aiken County, 6-xxx Barnwell County) were read from the map face (no logs printed). Exposure and borrow-pit marks carry no labels. 'Willoughby and others, 1995' is cited but there is no reference list. SUBSURFACE: none.
